gauge.name: Santa Cruz River at Trico Road

impacts.statement: Widespread flooding in Marana and Pinal County.
Berry Estates in Marana and Chui Chu threatened by flood waters. Trico Road and Marana Road bridges overtopped.
Trico Rd and Marana Rd bridges closed. Extensive flooding south of Trico Rd Bridge.
Overbank flow begins on Trico Road just south of bridge and Trico Road likelt closed. Berms near Sunland Gin Rd Bridge can be breached cutting off access to Silverbell Estates.
